dialogues.speaker: Ren
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、練習問題１０の問題をこの列の人、
　前に出てきて解いてください」
dialogues.en:
"Then, you over there, please write down the answer for
question 10."
dialogues.text:
"Then, you over there, please write down the answer for
question 10."

dialogues.jp:
麻生先生の指示に、隣の列の奴らがのろのろと
席を立ち上がり、黒板に向かっていく。
dialogues.en:
At Asao-sensei's instruction, the poor sap stood up from his
desk and started walking to the blackboard.
dialogues.text:
At Asao-sensei's instruction, the poor sap stood up from his
desk and started walking to the blackboard.

dialogues.jp: （なんでこの人は普通に授業を進めてるんだ？）
dialogues.en: "(Why is she holding a normal lesson today?)"
dialogues.text: "(Why is she holding a normal lesson today?)"

dialogues.jp:
他の講師はそこそこのやる気しかないのに、
淡々と教科書を進めていく。
dialogues.en:
Most of the other teachers just tell us to read the textbook
for an hour.
dialogues.text:
Most of the other teachers just tell us to read the textbook
for an hour.

dialogues.jp: 最後なんだから、もっと特別にいこうよ……。
dialogues.en: To the end, she's still as regimental as ever...
dialogues.text: To the end, she's still as regimental as ever...

dialogues.jp:
ええと……恋先生はなんだか今日まで普通に授
業を行ったのだった。さすが、笑わない女。
dialogues.en:
Uhm... despite today being the last day, Ren-sensei still
held a normal class. Just as expected from the "unsmiling
woman".
dialogues.text:
Uhm... despite today being the last day, Ren-sensei still
held a normal class. Just as expected from the "unsmiling
woman".
